title: Document GitHub Release CLI install and update workflow
description: Document user-facing install and update instructions for the GitHub Release CLI artifacts. Documentation should target early non-commercial users and should avoid npm-first language.
acceptance_criteria: README or dedicated docs explain how to download and install the CLI from GitHub Releases. Instructions cover supported platforms identified by the artifact-format decision. Documentation states that Eshyra is source-available/free for non-commercial use under PolyForm Noncommercial License 1.0.0. Documentation links to LICENSE and COMMERCIAL-LICENSE.md. Documentation notes that bundled rules/content may carry separate licenses and attribution requirements. Documentation does not describe Eshyra as open source. Documentation does not suggest npm publication as the primary install path.
notes: Four blocking installer correctness issues fixed (bb08422): asset discovery from GitHub API (not tag-derived filenames), version-pinned docs corrected (ESHYRA_VERSION to sh not curl; no iex -Version), docs path wording fixed (eshyra-<version>-<target> not just <version>), tests extended. All 1829 tests pass.
close_reason: Implemented and merged in PR #236 (feat: one-line installer, checksums, and release workflow validation) and PR #239 (Fix installer smoke test). Install/update docs added; asset discovery, version-pinned docs, and smoke test all corrected.
